title: Wire authorized Event Search Inspector browser to existing Go HTTP host
goal: Make the existing CAP-INV-002 Search result -> CAP-INV-004 Inspector -> same Search window traversal use a real same-origin HTTP POST to the existing host with negative authorization tests against a live loopback-only synthetic Go server, without claiming real IAM, provider, or production deployment.
invariants: Import frozen frontend inspection.mjs and inspection.test.mjs from PR #183 without modifying their bytes; keep #183 and #184 immutable
Browser transport uses fixed same-origin relative endpoint and never treats selection/scope/raw flags as permission
Real HTTP access is independently denied by trusted host session, Search Job membership and Telemetry Event owner; synthetic local fixture is not IAM
No raw-derived values when raw denied; frontend rechecks Job/run/tenant/environment before displaying or restoring
OPEN-013/014 mutations, storage, query execution, Case, Evidence and production API remain out of scope
security_properties: Fixed relative POST path with credentials same-origin, redirect error, no-store, AbortSignal, JSON-only bounded UTF-8 response
Host synthetic token is random per integration test and never emitted; listener binds only 127.0.0.1
Wrong bearer and wrong tenant deny without returning protected data; no client-supplied authorization rights
Oversized/non-JSON/denied responses fail closed before UI normalization; frontend textContent-only renderer remains unchanged

migration.rationale: Transport of read-only projections only; no persistence or schema migration

rollback.strategy: Revert H integration branch; source PR #183 and server PR #184 remain unchanged
verification: Independent Go host and Event Search frontend remain testable separately

inputs: Existing CAP-INV-002 frontend and E10-INV-004E first-party projection core
PR #183 frozen source blob IDs; PR #184 frozen approved-by-CI host SHA 239ad0950f35a283e8611baf599a652966822dcb, not native approved
Existing same-origin host endpoint with injected owner interfaces; local test fixture only
outputs: Actual Node fetch POST to live first-party Go HTTP host after Search controller selection
Go synthetic host uses independently-scoped Search and Telemetry owners, server bearer required only in test
Read-only browser inspection shows separate rendered/raw state and returns to same Search result window
Exact-HEAD CI: complete original JS tests, Go host tests, real local cross-language e2e, mandatory engineering checks
Explicit handoff and prior source blob provenance
acceptance_tests: Search controller selected Event uses the actual HTTP host and produces validated Inspector projection
Rendered authorized while raw and raw-derived are denied, and source/parser/enrichment provenance survives HTTP
Return restores same authorized Search result-window object after HTTP round trip
Wrong bearer/wrong tenant/foreign event deny and return no classified bytes
Bad Content-Type and >2 MiB response reject before browser displays result
Node24 and Go 1.26.8 tests run on exact CI SHA without real IAM/provider/API payante
definition_of_ready: PR #184 host code is published and green at base SHA (not merged)
PR #183 JS journey code is published and copied byte-identically (not merged)
OPEN-013/014 excluded and no owner auth behavior invented
definition_of_done: Live local HTTP bridge end-to-end successful at exact GitHub SHA
